Retirement Systems Of Alabama who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $817.59B market cap company. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 37.43% since November 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 21.81% the S&P500.
